title: 🖐️ Retro Player / Eye Frame Rework

accepted_baseline.label: Persistent low-res first-person scene
preserve: one coherent generated photographic hand identity

current_candidate.summary: Player V12 remains published but its eye framing/cropping was rejected by the user and must not be treated as accepted.

isolation_lab.summary: A deliberately minimal eye-only lab: one generated 2x5 blink grid, ten fixed 128x128 cells, one blink action per touch, no pupil, no alternate gestures, no per-frame trimming.

open_feedback: Review only the standalone eye blink before reintegrating it into Player.
Check that no eyelash/corner is clipped between frames.
Check that the same eye identity is preserved through all ten frames.
Do not add pupil, look-around, squint, twitch or other animations until this single blink is accepted.
